cases.evidence: Identity-bound JodiUSA grant, all 27 features available, $0 billing UI, no provider call/invoice, hidden paid checkout, no auto-consent and revocation/suspension protections pass. Full feature journeys remain open.

Eight actual failed-renewal/recovery checks pass: decline/past_due, failed local invoice, existing retry access, paid retry, cleared warning, same invoice, active subscription and preserved disabled feature. PostgreSQL covers unpaid suspension/recovery and canceled/newer-plan protection. Complete paid feature matrix and provider retry-exhaustion configuration remain open.

Existing usage/feature regression suite passes; free grant removes commercial caps without overriding safety/operator controls. Exhaustive paid quota boundaries and resource capacity are not certified.

Browser cross-tenant billing denial and tenant-host console isolation pass. Identity spoofing, copied grant, tenant setting spoof, unpaid feature switch and internal-plan purchase are denied in database tests. Full endpoint matrix remains open.

Standard Checkout selected explicitly. Actual hosted test payment returns to application, signed callback activates correct tenant, monthly renewal and annual interval/unpaid denial pass. Complete owner-initiated plan-management journey remains open.

Twelve final provider recovery assertions pass through registered signed HTTPS. Includes pending-to-success, success-to-failure, exact reversal, failed refund notice, signed records and late-event stability. Three real original events were resent. Invalid binding and API outage roll back acknowledgement; concurrent duplicate reversals pass on PostgreSQL. All cross-event ordering and production alert/retry operations are not fully certified.

Scheduled cancellation retains current access; actual test-clock natural expiry deactivates local access and removes paid tier, signed deletion recorded. Explicit cancellation also passes. Customer-facing cancellation-management journey remains open.

Supported USD single-payment refund flow passes: 9 real-provider refund assertions plus 4 partial/full ledger assertions and 2 operator-browser refund assertions. Pending refunds are not settled cash; successful refunds debit once; later failure credits once and flags follow-up. Signed delayed events, real replay, invalid bindings, outages and concurrent reversals are tested. No automatic replacement payment or refund of real funds. Unsupported proration/multi-payment scope is excluded.

products.note: Payment/refund recovery fix deployed with unchanged billing/settings/free grant. 313 PostgreSQL checks pass, including 100 added activation/verification/isolation checks and concurrent reversals. Real signed HTTPS: failed renewal/retry recovery (8 assertions), delayed refund settlement/reversal and late-event protection (12), partial-to-full refund ledger (4); 4 operator browser checks pass. Supported USD refund lifecycle gate passes. Overall entitlement task remains blocked by incomplete full journey/tier coverage and operations; paid tiers, commissions and campaigns unchanged.
